    4. If string `SS[i]` contains string `SS[j]`, replaces `SS[j]` with the last string in the array `SS[N-1]`, decrements `N`, and decrements `i` (bug is here).
    5. Converts the first `N` strings in `SS` to character arrays and stores them in a 2D character array `S`.
    6. Initializes an array `rhs` of `RollingHash` objects for each string in `S`.
    7. Computes a 2D array `E` where `E[i][j]` stores the length of the longest suffix of `S[i]` that matches a prefix of `S[j]`.
    8. Initializes a 2D array `dp` for dynamic programming, with dimensions `[1 << N][N]`.
    9. Iterates over all subsets of strings and updates `dp` to store the maximum overlap length for each subset.
    10. Computes the total length `sum` of all strings in `S`.
    11. Initializes `ans` with a large value `infL`.
    12. Updates `ans` to be the minimum of its current value and `sum - dp[(1 << N) - 1][i]` for each `i`.
    13. Returns `ans` as the result.
